Interface VirtualServer

All Known Subinterfaces:
VirtualServerRmi
All Known Implementing Classes:
GameController, RmiServer, SocketClient
public interface VirtualServer
Remote server contract exposed to clients. Each method represents an action a client can perform, from connection setup to in-game actions.

    • connect

      void connect(String playerName, VirtualView client) throws Exception
      Performs a connection setup, registering the client and returning a unique identifier through VirtualView.onConnected(String, List).
      Parameters:
      playerName - desired display nickname
      client - callback view used to push notifications back
      Throws:
      Exception - on transport failure
